programs.title: Zambia Untamed
programs.desc: As the dry season begins, thousands of animals are making their way to the Acacia Loop. Each must establish their place in the pecking order and avoid the dangerous residents who are all too willing to make a meal of the unwary.

director: Martha Holmes, James Smith, Kate Beetham, Hannah Hoare:Producers

programs.title: Zambia Untamed
programs.desc: Mvula is the youngest calf in the Madzi family. Temperatures are soaring. Lagoons and waterholes are drying up. This forces Mvula and his family to undertake a long and dangerous journey to the only remaining source of water: the Luangwa River.

director: Martha Holmes, James Smith, Kate Beetham, Hannah Hoare:Producers

programs.title: Amazing Animal Friends
programs.desc: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a duck that won’t go in the water without a ride from her pooch pal, an elephant that thinks she’s a buffalo, and a herd of cows that adopt an orphaned deer.

programs.title: Supersenses
programs.desc: See the animals that push the limits of physics, chemistry and engineering to pull off feats that humans can only dream of, and find out how evolution granted them with such amazing abilities. Sometimes it takes a super-power just to survive.

director: Bernard Rogan, Dan Chambers, Andra Heritage:Producers

programs.title: Africa's Wild Horizons
programs.desc: The Namib Desert is a land of extremes, from icy ocean to baking sand. It takes toughness and adaptation to live in this desert, and only a special few can. From the sidewinding adder to the fog-collecting beetle, each animal has their tricks for survival in the Namib.

director: Werner Hefer, Marius Burger, Rogan Kerr, Chris Mason:Directors

programs.title: Africa's Wild Horizons
programs.desc: The Namib is the oldest desert in the world, hugging Africa’s shoreline for over 400 kilometers. It is one of the most inhospitable habitats on earth. Yet the world’s largest land mammal has made a home here, adapted through behavior and designed to life in the extreme.

director: Werner Hefer, Marius Burger, Rogan Kerr, Chris Mason:Directors

programs.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programs.desc: Start a promising new term at the Orangutan Jungle School in Borneo. See newbie Bumi struggle to focus, track skittish Rumba’s first timid steps toward independence, and cheer on star student Valentino as he experiences a bumpy start to college.
